result.brief: 提出几何注意力蒸馏，将冻结几何模型的跨帧对应关系迁移到视频扩散注意力中，按噪声时间步选择学生层，无需额外推理模块即可提升长程场景与动态时序一致性。
result.reason: Distills geometry-model attention correspondences into video diffusion attention to improve cross-frame consistency, a representation/training contribution for video generation and world simulation.
